message:
Command `cat > /workspace/analysis.json <<'JSON'
{"sample_id":"arvo_12642",
 "fine_trace":[
   {"step":1,"file":"tests/fuzz/cli_uart_received.cpp","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput",
    "line":66,"var":"buf","code":"otPlatUartReceived(buf, (uint16_t)size);",
    "role":"source",
    "note":"Fuzz input bytes are passed as UART received data, becoming CLI command text"},
   {"step":2,"file":"src/cli/cli_uart.cpp","function":"ReceiveTask",
    "line":178,"var":"mRxBuffer","code":"ProcessCommand();",
    "role":"intermediate",
    "note":"On newline, accumulated mRxBuffer is dispatched to ProcessCommand for parsing"},
   {"step":3,"file":"src/cli/cli.cpp","function":"ProcessLine",
    "line":3775,"var":"argv","code":"(this->*sCommands[i].mCommand)(argc - 1, &argv[1]);",
    "role":"intermediate",
    "note":"Parsed command line tokens dispatched to ProcessService handler"},
   {"step":4,"file":"src/cli/cli.cpp","function":"ProcessService",
    "line":1641,"var":"cfg.mServerConfig.mServerDataLength","code":"cfg.mServerConfig.mServerDataLength = static_cast<uint8_t>(strlen(argv[3]));",
    "role":"root_cause",
    "note":"Length of argv[3] is cast to uint8_t (max 255) but not bounds-checked against OT_SERVER_DATA_MAX_SIZE (248). Values 249-255 overflow the buffer."},
   {"step":5,"file":"src/cli/cli.cpp","function":"ProcessService",
    "line":1642,"var":"cfg.mServerConfig.mServerData","code":"memcpy(cfg.mServerConfig.mServerData, argv[3], cfg.mServerConfig.mServerDataLength);",
    "role":"sink",
    "note":"memcpy writes up to 255 bytes into mServerData[248], causing a 7-byte stack buffer overflow"}
 ],
 "vuln_logic":{
   "source":{"file":"tests/fuzz/cli_uart_received.cpp","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput",
     "line":66,"operands":["buf","size"]},
   "root_cause":{"file":"src/cli/cli.cpp","function":"ProcessService",
     "line":1641,"operands":["strlen(argv[3])","OT_SERVER_DATA_MAX_SIZE"],
     "relation":{"op":"le","left":"strlen(argv[3])","right":"OT_SERVER_DATA_MAX_SIZE"}},
   "sink":{"file":"src/cli/cli.cpp","function":"ProcessService",
     "line":1642,"operands":["cfg.mServerConfig.mServerData","cfg.mServerConfig.mServerDataLength"],
     "relation":{"op":"le","left":"cfg.mServerConfig.mServerDataLength","right":"248"}},
   "propagation":[
     {"from":{"file":"tests/fuzz/cli_uart_received.cpp","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput",
       "line":66,"operands":["buf"]},
      "to":{"file":"src/cli/cli.cpp","function":"ProcessService",
       "line":1641,"operands":["argv[3]"]},
      "type":"data","via":["otPlatUartReceived","mRxBuffer","argv"]},
     {"from":{"file":"src/cli/cli.cpp","function":"ProcessService",
       "line":1641,"operands":["cfg.mServerConfig.mServerDataLength"]},
      "to":{"file":"src/cli/cli.cpp","function":"ProcessService",
       "line":1642,"operands":["cfg.mServerConfig.mServerDataLength"]},
      "type":"data","via":["cfg.mServerConfig.mServerDataLength"]}
   ]
 }}
JSON` executed with exit code 0.
